# `scope_get_slew_rate`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the list of slew-rate labels and the currently selected index.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | A |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x84c30 (64-bit build) |

Builds a request-local list of slew-rate labels and reads the cached selected index; no serial or driver call is made. Labels matching a numeric "x" suffix pattern are converted by the handler into numbers. The full constant rate list, and how fresh the cached index is, are unresolved. The mapping from index to a physical rate belongs to the controller and is not established. Served by the guider process (TCP 4400); a client on the main command port reaches it through the imager unknown-method relay, which is unavailable to guest-table clients. The native-handler grade below does not describe the relay. No serial traffic (firmware 9.31, READ): returns the stored rate index and names.

Side effects: Request-local list construction and a read of a cached index; no hardware access and no shared store written.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":5,"method":"scope_get_slew_rate"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_get_slew_rate","result":{"list":[1,2,4,8],"index":2},"code":0,"id":5}
```

Reply, err-315:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_get_slew_rate","error":"mount is not connected","code":315,"id":6}
```
